text: In Riehl-Shulman simplicial type theory, the hom type hom_A(a, b) represents:
choices: the type of directed morphisms from a to b (not necessarily invertible)
the loop space of A at a
explanation: hom_A(a,b) is the type of 'arrows' from a to b in the ∞-category A. Unlike a = b, morphisms in hom_A are not automatically invertible.
